answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 9854 Country: India Title: I have 5.5 gm. gold, 50 gm silver& monthly income Rs. 4500, what is masla of zakat? Question: I have 5.5 gm. gold, 50 gm silver& monthly income Rs. 4500, what is masla of zakat? Answer ID: 9854 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 5/8=L/1429) If the gold, silver and cash put together and the total price reaches up to the price of 52 and half tolas then after passing a year you will have to pay the Zakah of the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
